events.name: Bash

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find failing checks and source of weekday rule
events.input: $ V=d29a1055 node scripts/probe-keyart.mjs 2>&1 | grep -B3 FAIL | head; grep -n "stale weekday" -A12 scripts/probe-keyart.mjs | head -30; grep -rn "Registration closes" src --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read weekday check and copy source
events.input: $ sed -n 60,73p scripts/probe-keyart.mjs; grep -rn "Registration closes" src | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm deadline label comes from cohort.ts
events.input: $ grep -n "DEADLINE_LABEL" src/lib/cohort.ts src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | head -4; git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' -- src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace DEADLINE source
events.input: $ grep -n "DEADLINE\b\|const DEADLINE\|import.*cohort" src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | head -5; grep -n "DEADLINE" src/lib/cohort.ts | head -5

events.text: The /vip "fail" is a probe false positive: the deadline is the Tuesday before Day 1, computed from cohort.ts. I'm narrowing the probe so it accepts that line, then refreshing the links.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-run probe on live mirror and save output
events.input: $ V=d29a1055 node scripts/probe-keyart.mjs > ../workshop-plan/evidence/T-101/probe-keyart-2026-10-12.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -3 ../workshop-plan/evidence/T-101/probe-keyart-2026-10-12.txt; grep -c "0 broken, 0 bad" ../workshop-plan/evidence/T-101/probe-keyart-2026-10-12.txt
